title: Signal schema lacks awaiting_validation status and link types for incidentally-resolved signals
description: When a run incidentally fixes the issue described by a pre-existing signal, there is no defined lifecycle path. The current status enum (open, spec_written, candidate, resolved, archived, superseded) has no state for 'prospective fix exists, pending verification'. Marking the signal resolved is premature (unverified); leaving it open is inaccurate (a fix is in flight). The schema also lacks link types to record what run produced the prospective fix and which validation signal was created to verify it.
proposed_resolution:
Extend the signal schema and lifecycle as follows:

**New status enum value:**
- `awaiting_validation`: the signal has been incidentally fixed by another run; a validation signal has been emitted to verify the fix; the original signal is superseded pending the validation outcome. Named to match the existing descriptive-state pattern of the status enum (open, spec_written, candidate, resolved, superseded).

**New link types in the existing links array (not new top-level fields):**
On the original signal B:
- `{ "type": "fixed_by", "run_id": "...", "candidate_tag": "...", "branch": "..." }` — the run that produced the prospective fix
- `{ "type": "validated_by", "signal_id": "V-UUID" }` — the validation signal created to verify it

On the validation signal V:
- `{ "type": "validates", "signal_id": "B-UUID" }` — the original signal being validated
- `{ "type": "validation_type", "value": "incidental_fix_verification" }` — or as a top-level typed field on V

**Lifecycle:**
1. Run A incidentally fixes signal B → agent emits validation signal V
2. Agent sets B.status = awaiting_validation; appends fixed_by and validated_by links to B.links; appends validates link to V.links
3. V runs via a signal->validate workflow (lighter than signal->spec->run; no new implementation, only verification)
4a. V passes → V.status = resolved; B is archived
4b. V fails → V closes with failure recorded; B.status reverts to open; fix attempt appended to B.links history

**New workflow primitive required:** signal->validate (distinct from signal->spec->run). For moeb-internal signals this requires a moeb MCP workflow invocation context. Schema enum additions must be applied to signal.schema.json before any new status values are used.
